stories.title: Suvendu Adhikari sworn in as West Bengal Chief Minister on 9 May 2026
stories.body: ended 15 years of Trinamool Congress rule and formed the state's first-ever BJP-led government after a landslide win.

one_liners: Suvendu Adhikari sworn in as West Bengal Chief Minister on 9 May 2026 — ended 15 years of Trinamool Congress rule and formed the state's first-ever BJP-led government after a landslide win.
